artifacts.summary: Confirms the 4 CLAUDE.md standards pointers use a dead .claude/extensions/nvim/context/... prefix while the real files live flat at .claude/context/project/neovim/standards/*.md; recommends a direct 4-line prefix substitution; flags an archived same-numbered task's opposite-direction precedent as superseded by the current installed_files manifest.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, .claude/extensions/{ext}/ holds only the extension manifest.json plus symlink-installer targets for skills/agents/commands categories. Context/standards files are deployed flat into .claude/context/... by the copy engine (loader.lua), never nested under .claude/extensions/{ext}/context/.... The authoritative ground truth for which files are deployed where is .claude-extensions.json's per-extension installed_files list, not any archived task's assumption, since the deploy-path convention has changed over time (see .claude/context/project/neovim/domain/extension-deploy-modes.md).

Task numbers in this repo are recycled after vault archival (vault operation / task number reset). Task 294 was previously used for an unrelated archived task (fix_extension_dependent_refs) whose plan made the opposite path-direction change now being corrected. When grepping specs/vault/.../archive/ for a task number, verify it's not a stale, recycled-number hit before trusting its content as precedent.
